purpose: Thai → English → Simplified-Chinese patient-facing terminology for the aesthetic-clinic websites (waleeratclinic.com, waleeratinternational.com, verzoclinic.com). Chinese terms are what prospective patients actually search and use (Rednote/Xiaohongshu register), mapped to each site's canonical English program names. This is a linguistic resource: it maps TERMS, never claims, prices or credentials, and must not be used to transfer claims between brands.

reviewStates.site-published-zh: The website itself already publishes this Chinese term (verifiable at the live zh URL recorded in the site's llms.txt snapshot in this repo).
reviewStates.site-canonical: Canonical English program name from the site's own llms.txt program index.
reviewStates.site-keyword: Thai term published by the site as a brand/SEO keyword (clinic.json keywords).
reviewStates.kb-observed-th: Real Thai patient search phrase captured in the verzo evidence knowledge base (Google People Also Ask, intent-only review).
reviewStates.discovery-confirmed: Agreed by >=2 independent sources in glossary/evidence/ (Tavily web discovery). Still needs the logged-in Rednote confirmation pass.
reviewStates.discovery-single-source: Seen in one discovery source only; treat as hypothesis.
reviewStates.unverified-colloquial: Common-usage assertion without evidence captured here; do not use in publication copy.

evidenceModel.platformNote: The owner-requested logged-in Rednote (rednote.com) verification pass is PENDING: macOS Accessibility/Screen Recording has not been granted to ZCode Computer Use.app, so the user's Chrome session could not be driven. Until that pass runs and records in-app observations (post titles, usage frequency, trending variants), every Chinese entry remains discovery-grade and must not be treated as publication authority.
evidenceModel.disambiguationRule: Nicknames that identify a DIFFERENT product than the one named are recorded under disambiguation, not as translations. Example: 少女针 = Ellansé (PCL), NOT Sculptra — using it for a Sculptra program would misidentify the product.
